package.name: thunder_franka
package.description: Ament wrapper around the Thunder Dynamics generated library for the Franka manipulator. The sources in src/ and include/ are produced by `thunder gen` from franka_conf.yaml and must not be edited by hand: regenerate instead. The package exists so that the model can be linked into a node (the "in-process" alternative to the Robot Server) without duplicating the generated code in every consumer.
